label: ⚙️ Config-Driven Setup
info:
Auto-watches config.json every 3 seconds.
When a change is detected:
  • If projectName changed → RENAMES folder, DB file, SQLite table, backup files
  • Always → ensures dirs exist, syncs columns, updates flows.json + FTP creds + .dat files

Previous state is stored in global context so renames work correctly.

name: Auto-watches config.json every 3 s — renames existing resources when projectName changes
info:
Previous applied config is stored in global 'lastAppliedConfig'.
When projectName changes the flow renames (not recreates) everything.

name: Detect Change (mtime)
